intro: Football is Mali's favourite sport, and its basketball and athletics teams have had success too.

chapters.title: Football
text: The Eagles reached the Africa Cup of Nations final in 1972. Players like Frédéric Kanouté and Seydou Keita starred in Europe.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Mali's women's basketball team has won African titles, and its youth teams have done well at world level.
